title: RPSC Sub Inspector SI PET Admit Card 2026
vacancyDetails: Admit card / call letter for RPSC Sub Inspector PET stage 2026
qualification: Graduation or as per RPSC SI notification
ageLimit: As per RPSC Sub Inspector advertisement
selectionProcess: Written Examination → Physical Efficiency Test (PET) → Interview / further stages → Final Merit
documentsRequired: PET admit card printout; original photo ID; required sports kit as per notice
howToApply:
1. Visit https://rpsc.rajasthan.gov.in
2. Open SI PET Admit Card 2026 link
3. Login with application credentials
4. Download and print call letter
5. Report at venue with photo ID on allotted date
shortDescription: RPSC Sub Inspector SI PET Admit Card 2026 released. Download from rpsc.rajasthan.gov.in.
content:
Rajasthan Public Service Commission (RPSC) has released the Sub Inspector (SI) PET Admit Card 2026.

Candidates shortlisted after written examination can download the Physical Efficiency Test call letter from the RPSC portal and appear as per allotted date and venue.

PET tips

  • Check events and standards in official notification
  • Carry admit card and original photo ID
  • Reach venue before reporting time
